title: Help us improve NymVPN
description:
Choose what anonymous data to share. 
No personal information included.

connection.label: Your connection quality
connection.shares:
Connect time and error codes
Session length
Mode (dVPN / Mixnet) and exit server
OS, device type, app version
An anonymous ID (not tied to your account)
connection.never: your IP, browsing, or traffic contents.
connection.handling: Sent through the VPN tunnel to Nym. No third party.

monitoring.label: Your app errors & crashes
monitoring.shares:
Crashes and error messages
Where it happened (stack traces)
OS, device type, app version
monitoring.never: personal info, browsing, or traffic content.
monitoring.handling: Handled by Sentry, a third-party service. Nym never sees your IP.
